S329: The Sector Load Monitor provides the operational view of expected demand against the reduced sector capacity and highlights intervals where overload is likely.

Answer "supported" only if the sentences state that Sector Load Monitor produces or sends this item AND that Slot Allocation Engine receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence). Answer "unsupported" if they describe different items, the wrong elements or the opposite direction. Answer "uncertain" if the text is not clear enough. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
